supports.question: Is the DVD visibly white rather than black?
supports.criteria: Pass if the DVD is visibly white; fail if it remains black; unknown if its color cannot be determined from the image.
supports.binding: Assess the DVD shown in the image, using the black DVD in the input image as the reference. Judge its visible color, not unrelated edits.

supports.question: Does the object visibly retain its identity as a DVD?
supports.criteria: Pass if the object remains visibly identifiable as a DVD; fail if it is visibly no longer a DVD; unknown if its identity cannot be determined from the image.
supports.binding: Assess the same object shown in the image: the DVD that was black in the input image. Do not treat unrelated changes as progress toward the requested transformation.

parsed.fulfillment_criteria: Combine both supports under the original request. Complete only if s1 passes and s2 passes. Partial if at least one support passes but the request is not complete; unrelated edits do not count. Absent if both supports fail, indicating no requested change has progressed.
